roadmapTask: Horizon 25 of the FeatureSync dashboard: put the dashboard's UI state (flag filter text and which flag rows are open) in the URL query string rendered server-side so a page is bookmarkable and survives a form submit; build the server-side flag filter on top of that contract while keeping the in-browser instant filter as progressive enhancement; and add a sticky Section Nav. Write POSTs keep re-rendering inline with 200/400/422 and draft values — redirect-after-POST is rejected.

amendments.reason: The contract told me to comment that "the term 'on' also matches 'off'". That is false: 'off' does not contain 'on'. The repo's real rule (app.js indexOf over key+' '+type+' '+on|off) produces one quirk mechanism, not two: 'on' is a substring of 'config' and of keys like 'onboarding', which is WHY filtering 'on' returns flags that are off. Amended so the comment and tests state the true mechanism; the goal, the rubric and the 'two documented quirks' deliverable are unchanged and still met.
amendments.grounding: Verified mechanically: 'legacy boolean off'.includes('on') is false, 'pricing-config config off'.includes('on') is true. The roadmap's own discovery row (app.js live filter - exact semantics) carries the same incorrect claim.

changes: Add a short comment recording the two known quirks this rule keeps on purpose: the term 'on' also matches 'off', and 'on' also matches a key containing 'config'. Keeping them means no behaviour change for existing users.

Add a short comment recording the quirk this rule keeps on purpose: 'on' matches any flag whose key or type merely contains those letters (every 'config' flag, any key like 'onboarding'), so filtering 'on' also returns flags that are off. Note explicitly that 'off' does not contain 'on' - the overlap runs one way. Keeping it means no behaviour change for existing users.

bestScoringTurn is an explicit fold, not Array.sort: fewer failingCount, then strictly greater summedScore, equality keeps the incumbent (earliest by construction); the doc comment spells the three levels out and says the last is explicit rather than left to sort stability. PassTurnScore/PassTurnDimensionScore in types.ts and readonly turnScores on PassRunSuccess, additively (typecheck green; one test double was the only fallout); every scored turn is listed, not just the winner.
